$sources: NZS 3101:2006 A3 2.4, 4, 7.6, 12.7; NZS 1170.5:2004 5.3.1.2 (the clause of each check this pack covers)
source: NZS 3101:2006 A3: the clauses of the checks of the member design this pack covers (alpha 9 C18b), without the code's name (tableCodes names it). A group given here is given whole (it replaces the Australian pack's); a key without a counterpart is empty, so the row names the code without a clause. Groups not given are the parent packs' and named after them.
methodBasis: its strength reduction factors (2.3.2.2) and rectangular stress block (7.4.2.7); the methods it does not give are the parent packs', named in their lines

sources.check.torsion: NZS 3101:2006 7.6: torsion by the thin-walled tube (the parent's method of the same form: threshold, Ao, At/s, Al; the constants are the parent pack's, to verify against 7.6.1-7.6.4)
sources.check.deflection: NZS 3101:2006 2.4.2 and 6.8 (Ie); the limits are the parent's (to verify against AS/NZS 1170.0 Appendix C)
sources.check.columnShear: NZS 3101:2006 10.3.10 (shear of columns); the computation is the parent's (to verify: NZS vc with the axial factor)
sources.punching.punching: NZS 3101:2006 12.7.3: vc of two-way shear by the least of three expressions (the parent's form with 0.17 (1 + 2/β), (αs d/b0 + 2) and 0.33; NZS 3101 writes 1/6 and 1/3 with kds: to verify)
sources.wallsRows: the walls' check rows: minimum steel, spacing, shear and compression (alpha 9 C18c); keys without a counterpart empty (named without a clause)
